title: Einkaufszettel
list.label: Shopping list
search.label: Search or create an item
field.name: Name
error.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
error.name: Please enter a name.
error.forbidden: You have no access to Einkaufszettel.
empty.title: No items yet
empty.text: Type a name above and create it. After that, one tap on + puts it on the shopping list.
hint.readonly: You can only view the catalogue.
hint.noShopping: You may not edit the shopping list.
hint.noList: There is no shopping list yet that accepts items.
error.load.unsupported.title: This Yuvomi has no module storage
error.load.unsupported.text: Einkaufszettel 2 keeps the catalogue inside Yuvomi and needs Yuvomi with module storage (currently the FlessingLabs test build). For an unmodified Yuvomi, use Einkaufszettel 1.1 with its own service.
error.load.unavailable.title: Einkaufszettel is not active in Yuvomi
error.load.unavailable.text: An admin can switch Einkaufszettel on under Settings → Modules.
error.load.forbidden.title: No access
error.load.forbidden.text: You have no access to Einkaufszettel. An admin can change this under Settings → Household → Roles & permissions.
error.load.failed.title: The catalogue could not be loaded
error.load.failed.text: Please try again in a moment.
error.nameLong: The name is too long (120 characters at most).
error.conflict: Somebody just changed this item. The current version is shown now – please check it and save again.
error.goneMeanwhile: This item was deleted on another device in the meantime.
error.full: The catalogue is full (1,000 items at most).
import.text: Adds items from a JSON file, for example an export of the old QuickShop service (version 1). Items whose name is already in the catalogue are skipped and left unchanged.
import.invalid: This file is not a QuickShop export.
